goal: Build a production-quality Flutter application that mirrors the provided family wallet UI screens while extending them into a full ecosystem covering onboarding, authentication, catalog management, comparisons, and personalization. Follow the specified design language precisely and use only the allowed dependencies.

language_support.localization_notes: Provide AR and EN ARB files for all strings. Mirror layout direction (RTL/LTR) automatically.

iconography.usage: Use Iconly Light for neutral states and Iconly Bold for primary CTA buttons

principles: Use AnimatedSwitcher, AnimatedPositioned, AnimatedOpacity for micro-interactions
Implement hero transitions between cards and detail modals
Onboarding story auto-plays using PageController with Timer-driven animations
Use staggered animations for card entrance and skeleton fade-ins
When images are tapped, animate expansion into a 3D-styled overlay using Transform and perspective
animation_strategy.skeleton_loading: Provide shimmering skeleton placeholders for all list/card content while loading

architecture.state_management: Use ValueNotifier + ChangeNotifier + StreamController for partial rebuilds (no full page refresh)
architecture.storage: shared_preferences for theme, onboarding completion, auth tokens (mocked)
architecture.network: Use mock repositories returning Future-delayed data (no real backend)

pagination.strategy: Manual pagination with ScrollController listeners, requesting chunks of 10 items

global_widgets.PrimaryScaffold: Handles AppBar, bottom navigation, adaptive padding, dark mode, and localized directionality
global_widgets.BottomNavBar: Five-item nav with central floating action button style matching design
global_widgets.PrimaryCard: Rounded card with configurable gradient, badge, CTA buttons, percentage indicator
global_widgets.Animated3DViewer: Widget using Transform, AnimatedScale, and GestureDetector to present pseudo-3D product/media view
global_widgets.StrengthMeter: Password strength indicator with color-coded bars
global_widgets.ComparisonToggle: Checkbox-like chip that feeds selected items into comparison panel
global_widgets.SearchBar: Debounced search tied to catalog results
global_widgets.FilterSheet: Modal bottom sheet with segmented filters and range sliders
global_widgets.AIHintButton: Outlined button with icon and tooltip that will later connect to AI service
global_widgets.ExperiencePulseBanner: Live bilingual ticker showing blueprint pulses and highlighting related items
global_widgets.FocusDeck: Phase focus controller with elapsed timer, mood chip, and quick release stored via shared_preferences
global_widgets.ChronicleTimeline: Horizontal timeline of stored moments (pulses, progress, reflections) with direct refocus actions
global_widgets.OrbitNavigator: Horizontal orbit deck with intensity meter, manual/auto cycling, and quick item chips persisted via shared_preferences
global_widgets.ConstellationDeck: Constellation weave displaying energy, synergy, anchor items, and align controls with local persistence
global_widgets.HorizonBridge: Horizon bridges fusing constellations with coherence meters, intensity sweeps, blended mood chips, and shared_preferences state

modules.name: onboarding
modules.description: Auto-playing story onboarding that showcases app benefits with progress dots and CTA

features: Three slides derived from reference colors; auto-scroll every 4 seconds
Persistent controls: skip, next/back, dot indicators
Animated illustrations using 3D-style cards stacked with Transform
Call-to-action button leading to authentication flow
SharedPreferences flag to skip on subsequent launches

modules.name: authentication
modules.description: Comprehensive auth flow (mocked) with password policies and guest access

features: Email/phone input with validation
Password field with visibility toggle
Remember me toggle stored via shared_preferences
Guest login button that sets mock session
Link to password recovery
Multi-step form (personal info -> verification -> credentials)
Password strength meter using StrengthMeter widget with rules display
Terms agreement checkbox
Animated step transitions
Mock OTP verification modal
Choice between email or phone recovery
OTP input fields with auto-advance
Reset password form with strength indicator
Success animation
Mock verification via code entry
Countdown timer animation
Resend button with disabled state

modules.name: dashboard
modules.description: Home experience inspired by reference screens with cards, progress, and quick actions

features: Welcome header with user avatar, greeting, and Iconly icons for notifications/settings
Auto-playing onboarding steps card carousel with progress percentage
Wallet summary cards (Spending, Savings, Allowance) following reference layout
Location sharing panel with map thumbnail placeholder and toggle
Family accounts list with send/request money buttons
Bottom navigation persistent across app
Pull-to-refresh to reload mock data
Paginated lists for activity feed and recommended actions

modules.name: catalog
modules.description: Catalog of financial plans/items supporting search, filters, pagination, and comparisons

features: SearchBar at top filtering across name, category, tags
Segmented control to switch between grid and list views
FilterSheet triggered via icon: sort by cost, allowance, popularity; range sliders
Each item card uses Animated3DViewer for hero image, quick stats, add-to-compare button
Infinite scroll pagination with loader skeletons
Pull-to-refresh resets to first page
Pinned comparison bar showing selected items with remove chips
Detailed comparison table with animated column reveal
Option to highlight best metrics per row
AIHintButton to request smart suggestion (placeholder only)
Triggered by tapping catalog card
Image expands into top overlay with 3D flip animation
Second tap flips card to reveal extended description, benefits, and charts
Tabs for Overview, Transactions, Goals
Related items carousel with pagination
Button to add item to family member

modules.name: experience_lab
modules.description: Neo Experience Lab orchestrating story-driven blueprints that sync catalog favorites with showroom moods

features: Pinned blueprint hero card with auto-progress bar and mood chip
ExperiencePulseBanner streaming pulses generated from favorites and showroom scenes (no external backend)
List of blueprints with expandable phases, per-phase progress controls, and pin/unpin actions
Phase tiles expose estimated minutes, focus tags, and action buttons to open immersive viewer
RefreshIndicator clears cached progress and regenerates localized pulses
Stream-based ticker animates when new signals are emitted
FocusDeck surfaces the active phase with elapsed timer, related catalog items, and release control persisted locally
ChronicleTimeline shows stored pulses/progress/reflection/orbit moments with bilingual labels and quick refocus shortcuts
OrbitNavigator cycles resonance orbits, exposes intensity metrics, and links to synced catalog items without backend calls
ConstellationDeck weaves orbit intensities into alignable constellations with energy gauges, synergy badges, and anchor chips saved in preferences
HorizonBridge presents cross-constellation narratives with intensity sweeps, coherence gauges, mood blend chips, and quick item launches stored locally

modules.name: finance_tools
modules.description: Utilities for tracking spending, allowances, and sending money

features: Charts using CustomPaint to avoid extra packages
Skeletons while loading analytics
Filter chips for timeframe
Pull-to-refresh and manual pagination for transactions
Comparison toggle to contrast two members' spending
Wallet balance hero card with add/send actions
Transaction timeline with lazy loading
Expandable family member cards with allowances and quick transfer
Toggle to show allowances in list or comparison view
AIHintButton for budgeting tips (placeholder)

modules.name: profile_and_settings
modules.description: User profile, customization, notifications, and help

features: Editable avatar with network image and fallback initials
List of linked family members with add/remove
Security section showing 2FA status, device list
Language switcher (ar/en) with immediate rebuild
Dark mode toggle and primary color picker
Paginated notification feed with grouped sections
Swipe actions for mark-as-read/delete
Skeleton placeholders for first load
FAQ accordion
Contact options (call, email placeholders)
AIHintButton describing upcoming AI assistant feature
Troubleshooting tips cards with animations

mock_data_strategy.error_states: Randomly throw exceptions in debug mode to test skeleton + retry UI

testing_and_quality.widget_tests: Cover onboarding auto-play, password strength logic, pagination state
testing_and_quality.golden_tests: Validate light/dark and AR/EN layouts for primary cards
testing_and_quality.accessibility: Ensure minimum contrast ratios, support screen readers with semantics

delivery_notes: Do not integrate any external backend or networking library
All images must use NetworkImage with placeholders
Ensure every scrollable surface has RefreshIndicator
Implement manual pagination and maintain state between tabs
Respect RTL when locale is Arabic and mirror transitions appropriately
